name: EC Healthcare
summary: EC Healthcare is an investment holding firm headquartered in Mong Kok, Hong Kong, in operation since 2005, offering medical and healthcare services in Hong Kong, Macau and the mainland. It reports medical, aesthetic medical with beauty and wellness, and other segments, covering imaging, surgery, dentistry, hair restoration, chiropractic and veterinary care. Brands include PRODERMA LAB and Swissline, and it was called Union Medical Healthcare Limited until April 2021.
